lesson.vi: Race condition thường xuất hiện ở 'đọc rồi ghi': SELECT balance, rồi UPDATE balance = x. Dùng UPDATE balance = balance - 10 WHERE balance >= 10 để DB tự xử lý nguyên tử.
lesson.en: Race conditions usually hide in 'read then write': SELECT balance, then UPDATE balance = x. Use UPDATE balance = balance - 10 WHERE balance >= 10 so the database handles it atomically.

skill.en: Read one section of RFC 9110 (HTTP semantics). Just one.
